section.name: Embedded databases
section.p: mvn -B -ntp test runs the database-backed regression tests against both H2 and HSQLDB, as well as the existing JDBC test doubles. HSQLDB uses the jdk8 classifier of version 2.7.4; its ordinary artifact requires Java 11. Each database fixture gets a unique embedded database, which shuts down when its last physical connection closes.

section.name: PostgreSQL and MySQL
section.p: With a running Docker daemon, use mvn -B -ntp -Pdocker-it verify to also run the shared connection-pool tests against PostgreSQL and MySQL. The Docker Maven plugin starts the databases, waits for the final server startup log after initialization, and passes dynamically allocated ports to Failsafe. Maven removes the containers and their volumes after the tests, including after test failures.

Use verify, since stopping at integration-test omits container cleanup and test-result verification. A missing daemon or failed database startup fails the build rather than skipping tests. -DskipITs skips both container startup and integration tests; -DskipTests alone should not be used to skip Docker.

The shared tests cover pool reuse, validation, invalidation, state restoration, rollback on return, CPDS logical handles, prepared statements, generated keys, and managed local/XA transactions with Geronimo and Narayana. XA commit tests enlist a second resource to exercise two-phase commit. PostgreSQL enables max_prepared_transactions for these tests.

Image versions are pinned in dbcp.docker.postgresql.image and dbcp.docker.mysql.image and can be overridden with Maven properties. Ports bind to loopback by default. For a remote Docker host, set DOCKER_HOST and override dbcp.docker.bindAddress with a suitable address on that host. The configured database users and passwords are only for these disposable test databases.

section.name: Reports and cleanup
section.p: Surefire reports are in target/surefire-reports; Failsafe reports are in target/failsafe-reports. The database is included in parameterized test display names, and container logs appear in Maven output. Docker CI jobs run on Java 8 and 25. The normal Java matrix runs both embedded databases without Docker.

Remove only the listed test containers with docker rm -f -v <container-id>. CI performs this cleanup automatically, including after startup failures.
